collection.name: Ordlinks
collection.description:
Ordlinks is a collection of 10,000 unique pixel artifacts on Bitcoin, the first and most efficient without recursion, totaling 1.46 MB.

Each Ordlink, inscribed as a dual inscription on one satoshi, pairs a normal Ordlink and a cursed inscription—both fully on-chain and self-contained—forming a Yin-Yang design that reflects balance and duality in the Ordinals ecosystem.

The collection showcases geometric Pixel Archetypes, including animals, structures, and symbolic forms, designed in a minimalist 45x45 pixel format. At 156 bytes, it’s native Bitcoin original artwork using Bitcoin’s limits.

Post-@rodarmor’s 2024 Jubilee ending cursed inscriptions, Ordlinks, the last Yin-Yang collection, gained rarity, tying to Yelo lore and the Singular collection.
